agents.key_saved: Key saved in the local secret store
agents.keys_help: Keys stay in this machine's secret store (0600), are passed as environment variables when the agent starts, and are never logged.
agents.lead: Coding agents connected over ACP. Their file reads and writes and commands all go through the FoxOS kernel: scope limits, write locks, approvals, audit, human takeover.
agents.license_confirm: {0} is licensed {1}; FoxOS cannot redistribute it. Confirm to download it from the official source onto this machine.
agents.local_help: A deterministic agent that needs no model key: delegation (@name), skills (/skill), file reads and writes, commands, memory and cross-machine actions all work. Good for trying things out and for tests.
agents.registry_help: Icons, versions and licenses come from the official registry:
app.dock: Dock to the side of the screen
app.docked: Docked to the side of the screen
app.subtitle: FoxOS
app.title: Bots
approvals.lead: When a bot wants to do something that needs your consent it stops and waits. Approval rules live in each bot's settings.
approvals.question: Allow this?
chat.enter_hint: Enter sends · Shift+Enter new line · @ delegate · / skill
chat.machine_tip: Machine this bot acts on by default
chat.pause_bot_tip: Pause only this bot (other bots keep working)
chat.reset_confirm: Clear the conversation with {0}? Memory is kept.
connectors.custom_help: Enter an MCP URL (https) or a local command, for example an MCP server started with npx.
connectors.lead: Connectors let bots use outside apps (MCP servers, OAuth apps). Each bot's Skills and access tab decides which ones it may use; write tools ask per the approval rules.
connectors.oauth_help: A browser opens for you to sign in and authorize; the callback only goes to 127.0.0.1 on this machine. Tokens stay in the local secret store.
connectors.remove_confirm: Remove connector {0}? Its tokens are deleted too.
connectors.token_help: Kept only in this machine's secret store, never logged.
control.paused_all: Human takeover: every bot is paused
machines.bot_id: Bot ID on the controller (* for all)
machines.code_help: On the controller, enter the URL, code and fingerprint under Machines → Pair. The code works once and expires in 10 minutes.
machines.grant_help: Default deny: only granted bots can act on this machine, and only with these permissions, apps and folders.
machines.host_help: Let another FoxOS control this machine: run foxos machine serve (or enable the foxos-machine service) and give the other side a pairing code.
machines.lead: One bot can control several FoxOS machines and several bots can share one. Connections use HTTPS with a pinned certificate; the host grants each bot separately and the audit log records who acted.
machines.name: Name
machines.no_cert: No certificate yet (created with the first pairing code or foxos machine serve)
machines.pair_help: Create a pairing code on the other machine and enter its URL, code and certificate fingerprint here.
routines.lead: Routines make bots do things on a schedule (at least 15 minutes apart, at most 20 enabled). The foxos-bots-routines timer runs them when due.
runtime.lead: The manifest pins versions, licenses and official sources, and downloads are checked against sha256. The ISO preinstalls only redistributable tools; the rest install at first login or here.
settings.active_help: When inactive it does not answer, accept handoffs or run routines
settings.approval_help: When a bot wants to read or write files, run commands or use connector write tools, these rules decide: allow automatically, ask you, or deny.
settings.apps_help: Only checked connectors are offered to this bot.
settings.cu_help: By default agent-desktop reads the UI, Jev picks each step and DeepSeek plans. When the UI cannot be read, it falls back to screenshot control or browser control automatically.
settings.cu_p_auto: Auto (Jev when a TypeSafe key is set)
settings.cu_policy_help: Jev takes about 0.1 s per step and reports a confidence; low confidence or repeated failures go to the planner. Deleting, sending or paying always asks you first.
settings.cu_surface_help: Auto: desktop apps use agent-desktop; apps without accessibility use screenshots; web pages agent-desktop cannot read use the browser (Chrome CDP / agent-browser).
settings.delegate_all: May hand tasks to any bot
settings.delegation_help: Which bots this bot may hand tasks to; depth and per-turn limits prevent endless handoffs.
settings.delete_confirm: Delete {0}? Its conversation is moved aside.
settings.hidden_help: Not shown in the list but can still receive handoffs
settings.instructions_help: Standing instructions included in every turn.
settings.isolated_help: May only touch its own folder bots/<id>
settings.machines_help: Check the machines this bot may act on and pick the default. The other machine must also grant it.
settings.main_always_active: The main bot is always active
settings.memory_help: The bot sees these memories in every turn; it can also write them itself (remember / bot_memory_add).
settings.model_help: Streams answers without tool calls; choose an ACP agent for files and delegation.
settings.name: Name
settings.notify_help: Tells you when handoffs, routines and channel tasks finish
settings.reset_confirm: Clear the conversation and memory of {0}?
settings.reset_help: Clears the conversation and memory; settings stay.
settings.role_help: One line; the main bot uses it to decide what to hand to whom.
settings.routines_help: Have this bot do something on a schedule.
settings.rules_note: Rules win over the mode above; during human takeover everything is denied.
settings.scope_help: A folder in the workspace; the bot may only read and write inside it.
settings.skills_help: Includes pstack's skills and principles. The bot reads SKILL.md when needed and the chat shows which ones it used.
settings.telegram_help: Talk to this bot through your own Telegram bot (created with @BotFather).
settings.title: Settings
settings.webhook_help: Other programs POST {"text": …} to this URL to talk to the bot.
settings.webhook_once: The URL contains the token and is shown only this once.
skills.lead: Workspace .foxos/skills, ~/.agents/skills and the bundled pstack. Type / to have a bot use a skill.
skills.notice: pstack © 2026 Lauren Tan, MIT licensed, bundled as is (see foxos/data/pstack/NOTICE).
